name: inwise-desktop
description: Use local Inwise meeting memory to prepare meetings, trace decisions, and follow through on commitments.

interface.shortDescription: Turn local meeting memory into useful context.
interface.longDescription: Prepare for meetings, find decisions, review relationships, and follow through on commitments using the meeting memory stored by Inwise Desktop on this computer. Reading is local; optional action writeback is disabled by default and requires explicit approval.
defaultPrompt: Prepare me for my next meeting using Inwise.
Show my overdue commitments and their source meetings.
Find the meeting where we decided the launch date.
